title: MemoSync: Co-Managing Developer-Agent Metamemory Across Contexts
abstract: arXiv:2611.24165v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI coding agents increasingly manage what context carries across sessions and projects, but developers have limited visibility into what these agents store, retrieve, and apply. This opacity creates a metamemory problem: the developer's meta-level judgments about what should be remembered are separated from the agent's object-level memory operations, disrupting the monitoring and control that keep the two levels aligned. We conducted a formative study with 12 developers and identified what they want to monitor and control across four dimensions of agent memory use. Based on these findings, we designed MemoSync, a co-management system that treats agent memory as a shared, operable representation: the agent proposes memory candidates and reports which items it uses, and the developer reviews, edits, and scopes them. In a between-subjects study (N=132) against two baselines, MemoSync participants achieved significantly higher task perform

translated_title: MemoSync：跨语境协同管理开发者与智能体的元记忆
translated_abstract: AI 编程智能体越来越多地负责管理跨会话和跨项目所携带的上下文内容，但开发者对这些智能体究竟存储、检索和应用了什么却缺乏足够的可见性。这种不透明性造成了一个“元记忆”问题：开发者关于什么应该被记住的元层判断，与智能体对象层的记忆操作相互分离，破坏了保持两个层级一致所需的监控与控制机制。我们对 12 名开发者开展了一项形成性研究，识别出他们希望在智能体记忆使用的四个维度上监控和控制的内容。基于这些发现，我们设计了 MemoSync——一个协同管理系统，它将智能体记忆视为一种共享的、可操作的表达：智能体提出记忆候选并报告其使用了哪些条目，而开发者则对这些条目进行审查、编辑和范围界定。在一项与两个基线系统对比的被试间实验（N=132）中，MemoSync 的参与者取得了显著更高的任务表现……
tldr: MemoSync 提出了一个让开发者与 AI 编程智能体协同管理记忆的系统，智能体负责提出记忆候选并报告使用情况，开发者则可审查、编辑和限定记忆范围，从而解决了开发者对智能体记忆缺乏可见性的“元记忆”问题。
